quarantine.standard_v1_source_face_aliases: OMITTED; schema-v1 readers fail closed with missing-key behavior

bottom_exterior_z0.source_face_identity: exact baseline face indices selected from pinned z=0/R20 planar triangles and mapped into local-B by source_face_ids

interior_floor_z2.source_face_identity: exact baseline face indices selected from pinned z=2/R17 planar triangles and mapped into local-B by source_face_ids

preservation: all preexisting rest and relief vertices bitwise
all noncap face connectivity, order, parent face identity, and source-corner barycentrics bitwise
all existing outer surface field/color arrays bitwise
the frozen patterned baseline outer color table bitwise

fixed_meshing_parameters.triangulator: SciPy Delaunay with Qbb Qc Qz Q12, each planar cap independently

prewrite_audit.interpretation: The unchanged noncap minimum-Q and maximum-aspect bounds do not block robust global improvement if both cap targets pass. The noncap aggregate is named noncap; no body/support subregion is inferred.

fixed_budgets.exact_patch_overlay_count: NOT_COMPUTED_BEFORE_GENERATION; source fails closed before NPZ save if any frozen aggregate/per-face patch budget is exceeded

lineage.new_vertex_lineage: each lattice vertex has one deterministic actual baseline cap parent face plus source-face barycentrics, independently checked by rest and relief reconstruction
lineage.output_face_lineage: each remeshed face stores source-face/output-face barycentrics for every positive-area source-triangle intersection polygon
lineage.coverage: per-output-face patch areas sum to output face area within 1e-9 mm2 or relative 1e-10
lineage.nonoverlap: pairwise patch intersections at or below 1e-10 mm2
lineage.single_parent_fields: explicitly v2-prefixed fields only when one actual source face contains the full output face
lineage.cross_parent_fields: v2 status=2, legacy single-parent sentinel -1 and NaN; complete CSR patch lineage remains authoritative

colors.outer_base_linear_rgb_provenance: must match the patterned baseline outer_color_linear_rgb table bitwise; not treated as one constant pigment
colors.planar_cap_field: frozen unornamented base_linear_rgb at source position; stored samples and sRGB conversion independently checked
colors.outer_continuous_field_gate: saved local-B and candidate finite samples, plus corner samples, compared at the frozen 1e-12 tolerance

quality_gates.independent_noncap_quality: recomputed from relief triangles and required to remain exactly unchanged
quality_gates.meaning: geometric triangle metrics only; not tetrahedron quality, solver quality, or mechanics h
